contract.objective: Build a separate order-invariant complete-sequence candidate that preserves native identities, exposes competing paths and withholds ambiguous admissions without replacing frozen science receipts
contract.source_rule: Use the census loader's complete frozen 10,329-record raw snapshot and exact acquisition/algorithm pins. No additional source or image acquisition.
contract.candidate_rule: Enumerate all native-ID paths starting at bracket value 0 under the six pinned patterns, consecutive numeric shutter/file counters, serial and optical-setting equality, required bracket mode/order and at most ten seconds. Never select a path by input order or by maximizing counts. Additionally require explicit-offset, nondecreasing recorded times across all slots. Preserve all native records and original side metadata.
contract.family_rule: Native paths sharing the same ordered nine-field metadata keys form a lossless candidate family, not a physical merge. All slot alternatives and original target/activity fields remain visible. No representative is chosen.
contract.abstention_rule: A family with a multi-ID slot is IDENTITY_ALTERNATIVES_ABSTAIN. Families in a connected component sharing any native ID are COMPETING_PATHS_ABSTAIN. Only a one-ID-per-slot family with no competing path is UNAMBIGUOUS_METADATA_SEQUENCE; this is computational support, not physical or scientific acceptance.
oracles: All frozen baseline native paths accounted for as supported or explicitly excluded
Competing-time-path abstention and no-tie hard negatives
contract.stop: Fail closed on a source/hash/scope/baseline discrepancy, duplicate native ID, budget overflow, incomplete ambiguity component or unexplained baseline exclusion. Preserve old route and receipts; candidate failure does not authorize a physical merge, count rewrite or external effect.

source_census_contract.objective: Census distinct raw-product IDs with matching retained camera metadata and test their intersection with the existing counted cohort without certifying physical identity or changing a denominator
source_census_contract.scope: Frozen raw crew-camera metadata assembled by Stages 10A and 10E, queried flight days 1 through 10, snapshot 10 October 2026; not a current archive or pixel census
source_census_contract.key_rule: All named fields must be single nonblank strings; preserve lexical values and leading zeros. Missing/multiple/non-string values are unkeyable, not matching nulls. UTC-semantic comparison is a separate diagnostic requiring an explicit offset.
source_census_contract.native_id_rule: One distinct product ID and capture stem per raw record; multiple representations are not pooled into this census
source_census_contract.conditional_diagnostic: Wrap the existing unmodified six-pattern action finder: original input order, reversed input order, and hypothetical one-representative-per-exact-nine-field-group lists choosing minimum or maximum product ID. All other records, patterns, counter/settings/span rules and source order remain unchanged. This is identifier-selection and reconstruction sensitivity, not physical deduplication or a corrected census.
source_census_contract.follow_on_diagnostic: After the predeclared reversal exposes a count difference, profile only the existing sort key (serial plus parsed shutter_count, with its existing zero sentinel). These ties are ordering ambiguity, not aliases. Count nonblank tags in each diagnostic's admitted identifier set to separate selection from reconstruction; do not choose a correct target value.
source_census_contract.stop: Reject a source/hash, completeness, scope, duplicate-ID or baseline-replay mismatch. Do not retry denied archive reads or infer a valid physical merge from a candidate match. Preserve original science receipts.
